title: Grok 4.5 Now Available in GitHub Copilot
description: Grok 4.5 model is now available in GitHub Copilot, expanding the available AI model options for developers using Microsoft's flagship coding assistant.

title: Cursor Start - India-Specific Pricing Plan
description: New ₹649 monthly plan for developers in India with local pricing, UPI payment options, access to Grok 4.5 and Composer models, cloud agents, iOS support with remote control, and extension capabilities through plugins and MCP servers.
author: Cursor Team

title: Dependabot Alerts on Malicious Packages Across More Ecosystems
description: Dependabot now alerts on malicious packages across additional ecosystems, improving security coverage for developers using GitHub Copilot.
author: GitHub Security Team

title: GitHub Actions Holds Potentially Malicious Workflows for Approval
description: GitHub Actions now holds potentially malicious workflows for approval, enhancing security by allowing manual review before execution. This addresses AI-generated code security concerns.
author: GitHub Security Team

title: ChatGPT for iOS: Voice and Visualization Improvements
description: Voice conversations now use selected ChatGPT voice with usage-limit warnings, improved task reconnection, Composer autocomplete enhancements, selected-text references preservation, improved goal controls, reliable inline table visualizations, and more responsive large workspace diffs.
author: OpenAI Team

title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains Adds Improved OpenTelemetry Configuration and Model Management
description: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now includes improved OpenTelemetry configuration and model management capabilities for better observability and control of AI coding assistance.
author: GitHub Copilot Team

title: Manage GitHub Copilot App Access with a Dedicated Policy
description: New policy allows organizations to manage GitHub Copilot app access with dedicated controls, providing better governance for AI coding tools in enterprise environments.
author: GitHub Copilot Team

title: Enterprise Managed Settings in GitHub Copilot App and Copilot Cloud Agent
description: Enterprise managed settings now apply to the GitHub Copilot app and Copilot cloud agent, providing better governance for organizations using AI coding tools.
author: GitHub Copilot Team

title: Nanbeige4.2-3B: Unlocking Agentic Capabilities in a Compact Model
description: 3B parameter model demonstrating strong performance across code-agent, office-agent, and complex tool-use tasks while maintaining competitive reasoning capabilities. Outperforms larger models across diverse agentic benchmarks.
author: ArXiv researchers

title: Coupled Hierarchical Search over Topology and Execution for Agentic Workflow Synthesis
description: Introduces HierFlow, a test-time hierarchical search for automating agentic workflow design by merging feedback-guided topology adjustments with MCTS-inspired tree search. Consistently outperforms baselines across question answering, mathematical reasoning, and code generation benchmarks.
author: ArXiv researchers

title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
description: Training-free framework that compiles successful traces into reusable skill records persisting during inference. Achieves best accuracy-cost tradeoff among evaluated baselines on HumanEval and GSM8K benchmarks. On code generation tasks, reaches strong performance while using fewer tokens than baseline methods.
author: ArXiv researchers

title: Claude Opus 5: Anthropic's Premium AI Coding Model
description: Anthropic's premium AI coding model and command-line agent with enhanced autonomous capabilities. Writes clean, tight diffs with no dead code and serves as a stronger hazard spotter on subtle, codebase-specific issues. Became the default Opus model in Claude Code within 24 hours of launch.
author: Anthropic

title: Claude Opus 5 Now Available in GitHub Copilot
description: Claude Opus 5 model is now available in GitHub Copilot, expanding the available AI model options for developers with Anthropic's latest coding-focused model.
author: GitHub Copilot Team

title: Devin: Redesigned Model Picker and Slash Commands
description: Redesigned model picker with single organized menu, slash commands in message box (/btw, /queue, /ask), playbook previews on hover, and Windows sessions from Slack via !windows command.
author: Devin AI Team

title: ChatGPT Voice and Multi-Folder Projects (v26.715)
description: Voice mode powered by GPT-Live for coordinating tasks in ChatGPT desktop, plus support for local projects that can include multiple related folders with primary folder designation. Community feedback: 'ChatGPT just quietly became a full coding machine. Everything Codex can do now lives right inside the ChatGPT desktop app.'
author: OpenAI Team

title: Copilot Cloud Agent for Linear Generally Available
description: Copilot cloud agent for Linear is now generally available, enabling AI-powered task management for Linear workflows and project management.
author: GitHub Copilot Team

title: GitHub MCP Server Supports Next MCP Specification
description: GitHub MCP Server now supports the next MCP specification, enabling improved integration with the Model Context Protocol ecosystem for AI coding tools.
author: GitHub Team

title: Smarter Linear Thread Handling and Devin Outposts
description: Smarter Linear thread handling routing replies correctly, automations consumption visibility showing ACUs per session, Slack channel improvements for automations, safer MCP access changes, and Devin Outposts introduced for running workloads in your environment. Community feedback mixed: 'Devin AI Has Come a Long Way' vs 'We tested Devin on 20 tasks and it was a colossal failure'.
author: Devin AI Team

title: Cursor Router Auto Mode
description: Auto mode now powered by Cursor Router, which analyzes requests and routes them to appropriate models. Offers three optimization modes: Intelligence (frontier quality), Balance (strong quality), and Cost (optimized token spend). Admin controls enable per-team/group enablement and model restrictions. Community feedback: 'Auto Intelligence mode delivers output at ~60% lower cost for teams while matching frontier model quality' but 'lacks in memory and learning from mistakes'.
author: Cursor Team

title: New Copilot Usage Metrics Impact Dashboard
description: New dashboard provides visibility into Copilot usage metrics and impact, helping organizations track adoption and value of AI coding tools across their teams.
author: GitHub Copilot Team

title: Gemini 3.6 Flash Now Available in GitHub Copilot
description: Gemini 3.6 Flash model is now available in GitHub Copilot, providing faster response times for certain coding tasks and expanding model options.
author: GitHub Copilot Team

title: Paginated Thread History and Bedrock Support (v0.145.0)
description: Experimental paginated thread history with efficient search, expanded import migration from Cursor and Claude Code, Amazon Bedrock login support, audio inputs capability, and stabilized multi-agent V2 experience for AI coding CLI.
author: Codex CLI Team

title: Fireside Chat with Claude Code Team: Cat (Research Engineer) and Thariq (Product Engineer)
description: Interview covering Anthropic's AI coding practices. Key insights: Claude Tag handles 65% of product engineering PRs through Slack integration; prompt engineering has evolved - system prompts reduced by 80%, adding examples is 'no longer best practice', and lists of constraints can reduce quality. Cultural shifts include 'rewrites are now good', timeline from idea to implementation dropped from 6-12 months to ~1 week, and PMs becoming hybrid engineer/designer/PM roles. Security approach uses 'Swiss cheese defense model' with credential injection preventing agents from storing API keys directly.
author: Simon Willison (interviewing Anthropic's Claude Code team)
